cards.name: Actinomycosis
cards.clue: Jaw angle, "woody" induration, sinuses discharging **sulphur granules**

cards.name: Hidradenitis suppurativa
cards.clue: Axilla/groin, recurrent painful nodules, double-ended comedones, no systemic TB

cards.name: Lymphoma / metastatic nodes
cards.clue: Rubbery or hard nodes, B symptoms — biopsy

cards.name: Pyogenic abscess / infected cyst
cards.clue: Acute, hot, tender, fluctuant, responds to drainage/antibiotics

items.t: Cough, weight loss, night sweats or haemoptysis: urgent chest assessment.
Rifampicin is a strong enzyme inducer: review every interacting drug (contraceptives, anticoagulants, antiretrovirals).

pearls.t: Hepatotoxicity (RHZ): counsel to report jaundice, dark urine, vomiting; avoid alcohol; LFT monitoring per specialist.
Ethambutol: report any visual change (colour vision) immediately.
A chronic painless neck lump/sinus, especially with cough, weight loss, or origin from a high-incidence country, is **TB until proven otherwise** — do not repeatedly treat with flucloxacillin.
Skin lesions heal with scarring; tuberculids clear only with anti-TB treatment of the hidden focus.
